The input models scale it to a recipe's PSD and porosity by relative Kozeny–Carman, κ₀ = κ_ref·(D32/D32_ref)²·KC(ε)/KC(ε_ref).

relation.formula: Pre-calibration value: κ_ref such that generic 18 g → 36 g recipes at a flat 9 bar (six grinder presets at their default settings, 58 mm 18 g precision basket, medium washed Arabica) reach 36 g in 30 s at tier 1: geometric mean 2.41×10⁻¹⁴ m², spread ×1.14 (2.09–3.02×10⁻¹⁴). The calibration (data/calibration/current.yaml) replaces it with the pooled per-dataset bare κ₀ of V1 and V4, each divided by the builder's scaling for that case's own built Sauter diameter.

parameters.conditions: Wetted bed at the reference Sauter diameter (165 µm by default) and the registry's intergranular porosity; hot water; no compaction, swelling, gas or dissolution.

parameters.name: Slope of the fines weight in the coarse mode
parameters.description: Slope of the grinder model's fines relation, logit w_f = logit w_340 − γ ln(μ_c/μ_340): how fast the volume weight w_f of the fines component grows as the coarse mode μ_c shrinks. The relation is anchored where the grinder's median is 340 µm and its volume share below 100 µm is u_G.

relation.formula: Each measured (X50, Q100) pair was converted to the mixture's (μ_c, w_f) with this file's fines and boulder components (μ_f 40 µm, σ_f 0.6, σ_c 0.35, w_b 0.05), and logit w_f was regressed on ln μ_c for each grinder: Corrochano 2017 disc grinder ΨA–ΨE (dry laser diffraction, X50 61–383 µm) 2.06 with rms 0.006 in logit, and its roller grinder ΨF–ΨH (X50 602–1297 µm) 2.35; Smrke 2024 Bentwood V63 (Camsizer, X50 232–352 µm) 2.01 with rms 0.013; Cameron 2020 EK43 (laser diffraction, X50 205–360 µm) 1.59 with rms 0.02. With γ = 2 and one u_G per grinder the model reproduces Q100 within 0.4 points for Corrochano ΨA–ΨE (u_G 19.9%), Smrke (15.7%) and Waszkiewicz 2026's F64 EVO grind (X50 61–64 µm, 18.4%), and within 1.1 points for Cameron (16.1%).
